should_sync.description: Whether the schema should be queryable/synced.

sync_type.description:
Requested sync mode for the schema.

* `full_refresh` - full_refresh
* `incremental` - incremental
* `append` - append
* `webhook` - webhook
* `cdc` - cdc

incremental_field.description: Incremental cursor field for incremental or append syncs.

incremental_field_type.description: Type of the incremental cursor field.

sync_time_of_day.description: UTC anchor time for scheduled syncs.

cdc_table_mode.description:
How CDC-backed tables should be exposed.

* `consolidated` - consolidated
* `cdc_only` - cdc_only
* `both` - both
